prerequisites.title: Own Xero OAuth app
prerequisites.detail: Composio has no managed Xero app, so register your own Xero app and keep its client ID and secret.

prerequisites.title: Meet Xero's security standard
prerequisites.detail: Requirements cover API risk rating, authentication, certification, personnel security, encryption and audit logging. Two-step authentication is the minimum, and Sign in with Xero already provides it.

prerequisites.title: Sign Up with Xero before listing
prerequisites.detail: Implement Sign Up with Xero before submitting your listing, and write clear listing information.

steps.title: Register your Xero OAuth app
steps.detail: Log in to the Xero developer portal and create an app. Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard into it.
steps.done_when: You have a Xero client ID and secret.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the xero auth config through Composio's API using your client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: The auth config exists and a test connection succeeds.

steps.title: Draft security assessment answers
steps.detail: Prepare draft answers against Xero's security standard: authentication, encryption, audit logging, personnel security.
steps.done_when: Draft answers are ready for your review.

steps.title: Submit assessment and partner application
steps.detail: Review the answers, apply to the App Partner Program if needed, and submit. Expect about 5 working days of effort.

steps.title: Wait for Xero review
steps.detail: Xero takes 5-10 working days to assess answers. If you fail, you get 30 days for a remediation plan and 60 days to implement it.

steps.title: Monitor connection count
steps.detail: Track connections against the 1,000 mark and plan the advanced assessment before you reach it.
steps.done_when: A reminder is set at a safe margin below 1,000.

traps.title: 1,000 connections threshold is worded two ways
traps.detail: One passage says 'reach 1000 or more' and the affected list says 'more than 1,000'. Plan for the advanced assessment before you hit 1,000.

traps.title: Xero can require an assessment anyway
traps.detail: Xero may require one from any consumer outside the listed criteria, so staying under 1,000 does not guarantee you are exempt.

traps.title: Assessment repeats every year
traps.detail: Plan a yearly re-assessment; failing starts a 30-day plan and 60-day fix window.

traps.title: Managed Composio auth is not available
traps.detail: There is no managed Xero app, so you cannot prototype with Composio's own app.

traps.title: Subscriptions limited to three regions
traps.detail: Xero App Store Subscriptions is currently available only for customers in Australia, New Zealand and the United Kingdom.

blockers.symptom: Xero asks you to complete a security assessment
blockers.what_it_means: Your app is in scope: an affected API, 1,000+ connections, or Xero chose to require it.
blockers.what_to_do: Complete the annual self-assessment and wait for Xero's review.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft answers from your security documentation.

blockers.what_it_means: Xero gives you 30 days to submit a remediation plan and 60 days to implement it, then re-reviews.
blockers.what_to_do: Write the plan and fix the listed items.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft the remediation plan from the report.
